messages:
jules: FYI onboarding mistral-lite-int4 on dedicated revealed a small but reproducible drift for long ZWJ/emoji runs. generation starts sane then later tokens show strange repeated suffixes. could be rotary phase alignment + KV cache collapse under our compressed-kv path.
mei: can you paste a minimal prompt that triggers it? curious if it's tokenizer merging or a true rotary misalignment.
jules: minimal repro: "Translate to Spanish: Hello 1FA1F8\u200D4693FB3FC family!\n" (ZWJ + modifiers).
expected: normal Spanish translation with emoji preserved.
observed int4+compressed-kv: repeated tail: "familia familia familia..." and dropped some modifier details.
oscar: ran a quick debug run. differences: fp16 vs int4-compressed-kv:
- fp16 ppl=10.8, no repeat
- int4 no-compress-kv ppl=11.2, tiny wobble
- int4 compressed-kv ppl=13.4, strong repeat after step 24
also dumped KV length per step: compressed path shows num_unique_kv_entries plateauing early.
mei: tokenizer note: our normalizer folds some emoji sequences into single BPE token for space efficiency. that gives identical consecutive token ids for ZWJ chains. compressed-KV backend coalesces identical adjacent tokens into a single entry (intended) but our KV prefix indexer expects per-position unique offsets for rotary phase roll. coalescing removes the positional multiplicity, so rotary sin/cos alignment shifts for subsequent tokens.
jules: ah that explains phase drift — rotary uses absolute position multipliers; if we compress positions the phase applied at decode is off-by-N.
oscar: i pulled attention state diffs. the q,k projection outputs look fine, but the attention scores show a sudden phase flip at the index where compression collapsed entries.
mei: repro plan: 1) add test prompt with ZWJ+modifier sequences to onboarding set, 2) run fp16 / int4(no-compress) / int4(compress) and dump per-step rotary-phase offsets + num_kv_entries, 3) try pre-tokenizer that splits merged emoji sequences into separate tokens as a mitigation.
bot-ops: created job ml-debug-4778 to run the three variants on a small canary cluster.
oscar: quick commands i used:
```
python harness.py --model mistral-lite-fp16 --prompts zwj_repro.json --dump-rotary rotary_fp16.json
python harness.py --model mistral-lite-int4 --quant int4 --kv-compress false --prompts zwj_repro.json --dump-rotary rotary_int4_nocomp.json
python harness.py --model mistral-lite-int4 --quant int4 --kv-compress true --prompts zwj_repro.json --dump-rotary rotary_int4_comp.json
```
initial job outputs (small set):
- rotary_fp16.json: phase_offsets show steady linear progression
- rotary_int4_nocomp.json: similar progression, small quant jitter
- rotary_int4_comp.json: phase_offsets drop by ~12 at collapse point then resume -> causes periodic interference leading to repeats
mei: mitigation idea: when compressing KV, preserve a fake per-position delta (a 1-length placeholder) that keeps rotary phase increments intact but retains compression bandwidth. cheap and may fix alignment without changing tokenizer.
jules: that sounds promising. can we prototype adding per-compressed-entry phase padding in the compressed-kv map?
oscar: i'll hack a small shim that writes phantom offsets on compress and re-run ml-debug-4778.
triage-bot: created ticket INF-10022: "mistral-lite-int4: compressed-KV coalescing collides with rotary positional phase, causing repeated token suffixes" (assignee: oscar, priority: P2).
bot-ops: job ml-debug-4778 completed: shim with phantom offsets recovered behavior to within noise (ppl down to 11.0, repeats gone).
mei: next steps: 1) add ZWJ/emoji runs to onboarding eval, 2) add unit test for compressed-kv to ensure rotary cumulative phase preserved, 3) consider pre-tokenizer option as fallback for hosted A/B.
jules: rolling back the canary for int4-compressed while we land the shim and tests. please link PRs in the ticket. thanks! :sparkles:
